user.title: Daylight
user.description: Set up Daylight, then add profiles to it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Daylight is already set up. Add profiles to it instead.

data_description.wake_entity: Optional. A timestamp sensor, input_datetime or time entity. Its local time of day replaces the fixed wake time while it's available.
data_description.sleep_entity: Optional. A timestamp sensor, input_datetime or time entity. Its local time of day replaces the fixed sleep time while it's available.

data_description.ramp_duration: How long the morning ramp after wake time and the evening ramp before sleep time take.

data_description.enabled: Blend wake and peak brightness toward the winter values as days get shorter, based on your home's latitude. Each profile sets its own winter values.

data_description.timeout: Only used when pausing for a set time.
data_description.brightness_tolerance: Changes smaller than this, not made by Daylight, don't count as manual control.
data_description.color_temp_tolerance: Changes smaller than this, not made by Daylight, don't count as manual control.

data_description.entity: Optional. While this entity is on, each profile uses its night values instead of the curve.

error.same_times: Wake time and sleep time can't be the same.

data_description.lights: Lights, devices, areas, floors or labels. Light groups are expanded to their members.

data_description.wake_brightness: Only used when winter brightening is enabled in the Daylight settings.

data_description.brightness: Used while the night mode entity in the Daylight settings is on.

data_description.lights: Lights, devices, areas, floors or labels. Light groups are expanded to their members.

data_description.wake_brightness: Only used when winter brightening is enabled in the Daylight settings.

data_description.brightness: Used while the night mode entity in the Daylight settings is on.

error.no_lights: Choose at least one light, device, area, floor or label.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Ends manual control, including a pause, and adapts the lights straight away. Lights that no Daylight profile adapts are ignored.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Stops adapting the lights until they are resumed, also after they are turned off and after a restart. Lights that no Daylight profile adapts are ignored.

manual_control_started.name: Manual control started
manual_control_started.description: Triggers when Daylight stops adapting one of the lights because it was changed by something else or paused.

manual_control_ended.name: Manual control ended
manual_control_ended.description: Triggers when Daylight starts adapting one of the lights again.

is_adapting.name: Light is adapted by Daylight
is_adapting.description: Tests if Daylight is adapting one or more lights.

is_manually_controlled.name: Light is under manual control
is_manually_controlled.description: Tests if one or more lights in a Daylight profile are under manual control.

overlap.title: Lights in more than one Daylight profile
overlap.description: Profile {profile} includes lights that an older profile already adapts. This profile leaves them alone: {lights}. Remove them from one of the profiles to clear this.

migration_dropped_settings.title: Daylight profiles now share one schedule and curve
migration_dropped_settings.description: Daylight now has one entry with shared settings, and your profiles are part of it. The schedule, curve, manual control, winter brightening switch and night mode entity are shared and were taken from {source}. These profiles had different values, which were dropped: {profiles}. Check the Daylight settings, then ignore this issue.

resume_needs_target.message: Choose the lights, devices, areas, floors or labels to resume.

pause_needs_target.message: Choose the lights, devices, areas, floors or labels to pause.
